s1.quote: The cut is approximately 23 m (75 ft) wide and 9 m (30 ft) deep … snorkeling and diving are permitted on payment of a fee.

s2.quote: The maximum depth is around 30 feet … Currents vary with tides … All visitors, snorkelers and divers alike, must enter with a licensed tour operator and a registered guide.

s3.quote: Dive Site is 28 feet; snorkel site is 11 feet.

access.value: Reserve fee; licensed operator and guide required

highlights.text: Dense fish life, turtles and rays

summary.text: A shallow channel through the barrier reef off Ambergris Caye, about 30 feet deep, reached by boat from San Pedro. Fish density is high and turtle and ray sightings are reliable; tidal current varies.
